text.en: Chain-of-Thought Prompting is row 59 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: Chain-of-Thought Prompting 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 59 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates Chain-of-Thought Prompting with “Chain of Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Chain-of-Thought Prompting 与论文《Chain of Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Jason Wei, Denny Zhou”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Jason Wei（官方页拼写）、Denny Zhou（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Jason Wei, Denny Zhou”。
